description: Use this when someone asks about one named restaurant, bakery or café, like "is Nami Nori gluten free?", "can I eat at this bakery with celiac?" or "does this place have a gluten-free menu?". Returns Sansglu's gluten-free label and the place's own website as the source, or says Sansglu has no record. Do not use to find new places, and never for packaged foods, grocery products, brands or ingredients (cereal, sauces, beer).

query.description: What the person asked for and the area they named, in their words, for example "dedicated gluten-free bakery in Austin" or "Nami Nori Williamsburg". Never a street address or coordinates.

name: check_place_gluten_free_status
title: Check a place
